// Look for sc.exe disabling services
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
This query identifies attempts to stop System Restore and prevent the system from creating
restore points, which can be used to recover data encrypted by ransomware. Run query
Kusto
This query identifies use of wmic.exe to delete shadow copy snapshots prior to encryption. Run
query
Kusto
Instead of running several queries separately, you can also use a comprehensive query that
checks for multiple signs of ransomware activity to identify affected devices. The following
consolidated query:
| where ProcessCommandLine has "sc" and ProcessCommandLine has "config" and
ProcessCommandLine has "disabled"
| summarize ScDisableCount = dcount(ProcessCommandLine), ScDisableList =
make_set(ProcessCommandLine) by DeviceId, bin(Timestamp, 5m)
| where ScDisableCount > 10

hierarchy.parent: Check for individual signs of ransomware activity
